description: This file demonstrates usage of the Matrix library, specifically creating matrices, performing QR decomposition, solving linear systems, and verifying solutions by multiplying matrices.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: Represents mathematical matrices, providing operations like construction, conversion to array, and multiplication.

classes.name: QR
classes.description: Encapsulates QR decomposition functionality, providing methods to factor matrices and solve systems.

methods.name: solve
methods.description: Solves the linear matrix equation for the given target matrix using QR decomposition.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts a Matrix object to a PHP array.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies two matrices and returns the resulting matrix.
